## Reading: zh-CN edit-and-save round trip, per type

Reading taken 2026-11-18T00:19Z on `origin/main` a841e26b23 (the claim's anchor 4443014630 plus four unrelated commits; none touches `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/rest` translation, `ui/packages/data-objectstack` or the Studio editors). Live boot: showcase (`--fresh`), console on Vite (`DEV_PROXY_TARGET` to that boot), Playwright Chromium with `locale: zh-CN`; every captured write carried `accept-language: zh-CN` and the Studio chrome rendered in Chinese.

**Answer to the card's question: no. None of the six Studio editors stores the served translation as source text.** Every editor seeds its buffer from the untranslated layered read (`GET /meta/TYPE/NAME/layers`), not from the translated served read. A sibling console door that is not Studio does store it (report, below).

### Fixture

Writable en-source package `com.qa.tr` (POST /packages, project scope) holding copies of showcase items under `qatr_*` names (page, dashboard, report, dataset, book) plus a small app, and a runtime-authored `translation` item `qatr_zh_cn` (locale zh-CN) in the same package. Control before any edit: every item's zh-CN served read is translated (for example page label `我的工作`, dashboard widget `任务总数`, report blocks `未完成任务`/`已完成任务`, app nav `我的工作`/`工作区`, dataset measure `任务数`, book groups `入门`/`导览`), its en read and its `/layers` read are the en source. Second leg: the read-only showcase itself, edited through Customize into `com.example.showcase.custom`.

### Studio legs (Studio editor, unrelated edit, autosave draft, then publish)

| type | editor (path) | PUT body vs stored source | stored, writable leg, after Studio publish (raw + en read; pair drafts not published) | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| page | Interfaces pillar (writable) and Customize (showcase) | only `description` changed (+ `overrides` on the pair) | label `My Work`, header subtitle en | no echo |
| dashboard | Interfaces pillar and Customize | only `description` | label `Chart Gallery`, widget titles en | no echo |
| report | Interfaces pillar and Customize | only `description` | label and both block labels en | no echo |
| app | All metadata generic page, and the Interfaces nav pane (writable and showcase pair) | only `description` / identical to source | label `QA Translate App`, nav labels en | no echo |
| dataset | All metadata generic page (writable), StudioBundleItemEditor via Customize (showcase) | only `description` | label `Task Metrics`, measure `Tasks`, dimension descriptions en | no echo |
| book | All metadata generic page (writable); locked with no Customize door on the read-only showcase | only `description` | label `Showcase Manual`, groups en | no echo |
| mapping | not measured live: on `main` mapping has no translator (`METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS` has no `mapping` key), so nothing is translated to echo; PR 34976 (open) adds `mapping: translateMapping` to that table, and the editor gate below derives from the same set | n/a | n/a | NOT MEASURED |

Read paths (a841e26b23): `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/authored-layers.ts:79` `editsAuthoredLayers(type)` is `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES.has(type)`; consumers `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:3171` (page/dashboard/report), `:2819` (app nav), `StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx:334` (dataset on a read-only base), `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx:1514` and `:2151` (generic page: app, book, dataset). With no pending draft each falls back to `layered.effective ?? code`, which the layered read serves untranslated (measured: zh-CN `/layers` returns `My Work`, `Hours by Status (Summary)`, `Showcase`, `Showcase Manual` where the served read returns the translations).

### Server door control leg (shows why the client defence matters)

GET each item as a zh-CN caller is served it, change `description`, PUT it back `mode=draft`: all six types answer 200 with no advisory, and the stored draft and its en read carry the translations (page label `我的工作`, dashboard `图表画廊`/`任务总数`, report `任务概览（联合）`/`未完成任务`, app `翻译测试应用`/`我的工作`, dataset `任务指标`/`任务数`, book `示例手册`/`入门`). The restore is object-only at `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts:1138` (and `:1185`). Drafts discarded afterwards.

### Confirmed sibling door: the console's in-app report quick-edit

`/apps/com.qa.tr/report/qatr_task_overview`, admin button 编辑, change 描述, 保存. The config panel opens seeded with the served translation (display name field `任务概览（联合）`, description `将多个任务子报表堆叠在一个联合视图中。`). The captured `PUT /api/v1/meta/report/qatr_task_overview?mode=draft` differs from the stored source at `label` (`Task Overview (Joined)` to `任务概览（联合）`), `blocks.0.label` (`Open Tasks` to `未完成任务`), `blocks.1.label` (`Completed Tasks` to `已完成任务`) besides the edited description. After publish, the **en** read serves `任务概览（联合）` and the zh block titles: every non-zh reader now sees Chinese. Source: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx:60` seeds from `useMetadata().reports` (the translated list), `:222` `setEditSchema(reportData)`, `:200` `persistRuntimeMetadata('report', …, schema)`. Reach: writable packages only; the same edit on the read-only showcase report is refused 403 (save into the pair).

### Fix routes for the confirmed door (not built)

- (b) the editor reads the source document: ReportView seeds `editSchema` from `client.layered('report', name, { packageId })` through the existing `authoredBuffer`, keeping the served report for display. Small, ui-only, the same contract the Studio editors already follow. **Recommended**, because the producer of the off-contract body is this client.
- (a) widen the save door's restore to every translatable type's inverse. Protects every GET-then-PUT client (SDK, scripts, agents) as the door leg shows it is needed, but it is a save-door behaviour change across seven types with keyed array matching (blocks by name, widgets by id, nav by id, measures by name, groups by key); a decision for the seat, not part of this reading.

### Grade

The card's own trigger ("a zh-CN admin's ordinary edit would silently overwrite source text") is met, but by the console report quick-edit, not by Studio. Recommendation: re-scope to the ReportView door at p1 (or file it as its own p1 card and close this one as answered).

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Regraded p2 → p1, re-scoped** (00:2xZ), on the reading (area o3-I, 6965012558). The card's own p1 trigger is met, though on a different surface than the card first named:

- Studio does **not** echo translations for any of the six types; every editor fills its buffer from the untranslated `/layers` read.
- The **in-app report quick edit** (`ReportView.tsx:60/:200/:222`) fills its edit schema from the translated `useMetadata().reports`. An admin who presses 编辑 then 保存 in zh-CN stores the Chinese label and block labels as source, and English readers see Chinese after publish.
- The list-view config save (`objectViewViewCrud.tsx:121`, type view) may do the same. o3-I measures it on this card and folds it in if it is the same mechanism.

Seat route B: ReportView fills its buffer from `client.layered` via `authoredBuffer`, the rule Studio follows (ui only). The door-side defence for SDK, script and agent clients is a separate decision card.

Theme: zh-CN customers, with a named effect (an ordinary admin edit overwrites source text). The `domain:spec` label stays; the fix is ui.
